name: Hannover 96
description: The club with the motto "Never alone" has shaped Hanover for over 125 years. Hannover 96 brings people together - like a good ice cream sundae in the Südstadt.

name: gourmego
description: Natural ice cream raw materials from gourmego: 100% fruit purees, nut pastes and ice cream ingredients without preservatives. The basis for authentic artisan ice cream.

name: Bauer Banse
description: Regional agriculture from Bauer Banse: Fresh produce from Kakerbeck farm. Bauer Banse has been a familiar sight at Hanover's weekly markets for years.

name: Backring Nord
description: Backring Nord supplies ice cream parlors and restaurants throughout Germany. Experienced partner with a wide range of products for bakeries, confectioneries and ice cream manufacturers.

name: Leibniz
description: Leibniz Butter Biscuits from Bahlsen - Hanover's cult biscuit with 52 teeth. The classic accompaniment to ice cream and espresso, available in numerous varieties.

name: Machwitz Kaffee
description: Hanover's oldest coffee roastery since 1883. Machwitz combines traditional drum roasting with direct trade - the best beans from selected plantations.

name: Waffelfabrik
description: Ice cream cones and wafers in artisan quality. The Waffelfabrik supplies the perfect casings for natural ice cream creations - crispy and neutral in taste.
